name: 07 - Client Notifications
description: Shared notification service: sends templated email via Gmail OAuth2, optional SMS via Twilio if client opted in, and logs to notifications table. Called by other workflows with case_id and event_type.

parameters.query:
SELECT case_id, first_name, last_name, email, phone, sms_opt_in
FROM cases WHERE case_id = '{{ $json.case_id }}';

INSERT INTO notifications (case_id, event_type, channel, sent_at)
VALUES ('{{ $json.case_id }}', '{{ $json.event_type }}', '{{ $json.channel }}', now());
